query: Install Resonance into this empty project using the normal command. Do I need to choose source or compiled, and what happens if an old script still passes --profile compiled?
expected_behavior: Uses the complete installation by default, including .forge, generated skills, host adapters, bridges, and launchers
States that a new ownership manifest records the source profile
Does not ask the user to choose between source and compiled profiles
Explains that --profile source and --profile compiled remain compatibility aliases for the complete installation
